nodes.label: Inference evaluation scripts
nodes.rationale: Lightweight Python suite that runs Parish production prompt fixtures against local or cloud OpenAI-compatible targets to measure dialogue quality and support provider presets.

nodes.label: Evaluation target abstraction
nodes.rationale: Targets encode model, base URL, and optional API-key environment variable as model@base_url[#env:VAR].

nodes.label: Category sample generation
nodes.rationale: gen_samples renders two examples for each production inference category across configurable small and large model slots.

nodes.label: Dialogue flaw scan
nodes.rationale: flaw_scan flags non-Latin-script leakage, empty replies, and responses longer than 800 characters with configurable prompt and worker counts.

nodes.label: Canonical dialogue sampler
nodes.rationale: gen_dlg produces the five canonical dialogue samples consumed by the blind multi-candidate rundale-bench evaluation.

nodes.label: Measured model presets
nodes.source_location: Why keep these alongside the proof bundle?
nodes.rationale: Checked-in, rerunnable prompts make model selection evidence reviewable and comparable, replacing guessed preset choices and exposing drift from production prompt builders.

nodes.label: Usage-based evaluation cost tracking
nodes.rationale: Every run summarizes calls, input/output tokens, and estimated USD cost using provider usage blocks and a static price table that must be verified before relying on totals.

nodes.label: Independent Proof-Bundle Judge
nodes.rationale: A judge written by the proof author is not independent evidence.

nodes.label: Multi-NPC dialogue routing proof
nodes.rationale: Exercises natural-name and @mention routing order for two co-located pub NPCs and verifies that absent NPC names do not route after the player leaves.

nodes.label: Player movement log-heading proof
nodes.rationale: Moves around four stations to emit PlayerMoved journal entries whose headings use the configured player name or fallback.

nodes.label: Playwright cold-start proof placeholder
nodes.rationale: Explicitly records that issue 1086 is test-runner infrastructure rather than gameplay; the real evidence is ten repeated smoke-spec passes.

nodes.label: NPC departure destination-log proof
nodes.rationale: Waits across a schedule tick so character logs can be inspected for Departed headings followed by an authored destination body.

nodes.label: Schedule activity-log proof
nodes.rationale: Crosses morning schedule arrivals to prove authored ScheduleEntry activity becomes NpcActivity events rendered in character and location logs.

nodes.label: Gossip-spread log proof
nodes.rationale: Uses long waits to trigger deterministic Tier-2 gossip creation and inspect GossipSpread rendering in NPC and location journals.

nodes.label: Global weather-log proof
nodes.rationale: Forces a storm and changes location to check that weather or festival events are written to every location log.

nodes.label: Dialogue partner-heading proof placeholder
nodes.rationale: Marks a unit-test-driven change that adds the dialogue partner's identity to location-log headings.

nodes.label: Kilteevan alias-dedup proof placeholder
nodes.rationale: Records a data and unit-test fix for duplicated Kilteevan aliases rather than a live gameplay proof.

nodes.label: First-visit location-order proof
nodes.rationale: Walks a deliberate non-ID route so player.md can be checked for visited locations in first-visit order rather than sorted location order.

nodes.label: Addressed-absent-NPC event proof
nodes.rationale: Addresses Padraig from another location, expecting player feedback plus an AddressedAbsentNpc event in character and location logs.

nodes.label: Minute pluralization proof
nodes.rationale: Covers singular and plural travel and wait narration for one-minute and multi-minute durations.

nodes.label: Shared world-advance pump proof
nodes.rationale: Verifies shared wait narration, schedule tick handling, and continued status/look rendering after the harness delegates world advancement to parish-core.

nodes.label: Reaction emoji-monoculture proof
nodes.rationale: Saturates rule-based pub reactions with rent-language anger emoji and expects the session diversity sensor to emit a reaction-emoji-monoculture warning.

nodes.label: vLLM schema boot proof
nodes.rationale: Boots the engine and basic commands after a vllm.toml schema change; the actual round-trip schema assertion remains unit-test-driven.

nodes.label: Demo prompt UI-parity baseline
nodes.rationale: Captures GUI-visible location, NPC pre-introduction, fog-of-war, addressing, movement, and scene-description state that the Tauri demo prompt must match.

nodes.label: Location-context log pipeline proof
nodes.rationale: Exercises location profiles, movement, scheduled arrivals/departures, dialogue, mood, and relationship entries, including a round trip that previously duplicated arrivals.

nodes.label: Bounded log-writer backpressure proof
nodes.rationale: Drives a live server with burst movement, dialogue, and schedule events to prove bounded character/location log writing backpressures without loss, deadlock, or crash.

nodes.label: Active-mod selector baseline
nodes.rationale: Records the CLI startup location and scene so API and browser proof can establish which mod is active.

nodes.label: Pixi notebook gameplay-path proof
nodes.rationale: Shows the illustrated notebook continues to use live Parish gameplay state; browser evidence separately proves canvas pixels, hit routing, and selectors.

nodes.label: Physical NPC-arrival dedup proof
nodes.rationale: Round-trip movement demotes and re-promotes NPCs while proving only real physical arrivals and departures create journal entries.

nodes.label: NPC arrival-greeting flag proof
nodes.rationale: Shows the default-off flag mutes spontaneous greetings, enabling restores them, disabling mutes again, and dialogue/background simulation remain active.
